places.name: Cumaná
past: Planted by the crown’s order: a square plaza a block across, the church and the cabildo on it, and straight streets running out from it on a lattice of square blocks, the house lots drawn among the first settlers.
A great fire burned 6 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
The old tower keep was rebuilt as a great castle on the same ground.
The parish church was pulled down and rebuilt on its own ground as a great minster.

places.name: Villamora
past: Settled on the riverbank for the water and the fishing.
